defect: In this file the fix only replaces the hand-written Flatten plus validity copy with the equivalent helper CreateSortKeyWithValidity; the real #13934 bug was the missing NULL validity in GenericArgMinMaxState in arg_min_max.cpp.
reason: The change's PrepareData already marks NULL inputs invalid in the sort-key vector, so the fix's hunk here is an equivalent refactor and the repaired defect lies in another file that was already wrong.

defect: The added guard throws 'Multiple columns in ART index not supported' when column_ids.size() > 1, which rejects single-expression indexes whose expression references several columns; it should check expression_types.size().
reason: The fix changes exactly the condition this change added, from column_ids to expression_types, so CREATE INDEX on multi-column expressions works again.

defect: The fix only deletes a commented-out constant and unused private member vectors (blocks, offsets, data_pointers, ...) from CheckpointManager.
reason: Removing dead members is a cleanup; it does not repair any behaviour.

defect: The new Skip calls LoadGroup(group_state.values) before ScanGroup, but ScanGroup itself loads the group when GroupFinished(), so the metadata pointer is advanced twice and later values are decoded from the wrong group.
reason: The fix removes the extra LoadGroup call that this change added; ScanGroup's own loading logic is visible in the same diff.

defect: The fix reverts the CharDeleter functor back to the free function-pointer deleter, because the win32 segfault the change tried to address persisted.
reason: The functor deleter is functionally equivalent; the revert undoes an ineffective experiment and does not repair a defect the change created.

defect: The fix tunes the ETA display: it hides the estimate for the 2147483647 sentinel clamp added later, clamps the ETA near 100 percent, and delays Kalman updates until enough progress exists.
reason: These are heuristic and UX refinements built on later intermediate changes; the change's FormatETA ordering of the <0 and >99h checks is semantically fine.

defect: The fix retunes the filter constants (P, Q, R) and adds duplicate-progress skipping; the change only set R to 0.05.
reason: Changing noise parameters is tuning of an estimator, not a repair of a correctness defect in the changed line.

defect: The fix removes the schema_catalog_entry.hpp include that became unused after the catalog-reference WriteValue overload was removed in intermediate commits.
reason: Dropping a leftover include is cleanup; no build or runtime failure traces to the added include.

defect: The fix changes Insert to take const py::object & and stops moving it, to satisfy clang-tidy.
reason: This is a tidy-check style change with no behavioural defect.

defect: Making target_length int64_t turns sel_idx < target_length into a signed comparison, so a 0 or negative list_select index (sel_idx = value - 1 < 0) passes the bounds check and reads input_offset + sel_idx out of range instead of returning NULL.
reason: Before the change the unsigned comparison rejected negative indices; the fix restores idx_t types, undoing exactly the lines this change modified.

defect: The fix edits the test harness: RunParallel now actually sets threads and buffer_size, buffer bounds are adjusted, the buffer loop is replaced by a fixed size, and skip lists change.
reason: Both the change and the fix are test-only code (the harness ignoring its parameters is a test weakness), which the rubric counts as a test change.

defect: The fix restructures MergeJoinComplexBlocks's loop (separate fast path for l.entry_idx < prev_left_index, prev_left_index updated before advancing right) to remove a range-join benchmark slowdown.
reason: The change's prev_left_index logic produces correct matches; the fix addresses performance only, which is not one of the defect classes.

defect: The fix adds GetExamplesForFunctionAlias, which filters or rewrites examples so that aliases show examples using their own name.
reason: This is a documentation and metadata feature; the refactored helper reproduced the prior behaviour.

defect: InterruptDoneSignalState::Await reads the plain bool done in while (!done) and writes done = false without holding the mutex that Signal uses, which is a data race (UB) flagged by ThreadSanitizer.
reason: The fix takes the lock once and waits on the condition variable with the predicate, removing the unlocked accesses this change added.

defect: In this file the fix only changes auto callback_state to auto& callback_state in the debug async GetData and Sink paths; the lambda still captures a copy, so behaviour is unchanged.
reason: The copy into the lambda is safe in both versions; the real ThreadSanitizer fix in that commit is in interrupt.cpp.

defect: The fix makes comparison_type a per-match local initialised from comparison->type; the stale, accumulating flip came from the later ExpressionMatcher rework (983f6ea), which dropped the per-iteration reset.
reason: This change reset comparison_type = expr->type on every iteration, so the defect the fix repairs was introduced afterwards.

defect: ExpressionEqualityMatcher::Match names its parameter expr_ but compares this->expr->Equals(expr), comparing the member with itself, so it always matches and pushes the member instead of the matched expression into bindings.
reason: The fix renames the member and parameter so the given expression is compared and bound, repairing the shadowing bug added in this new file.

defect: In the new re-entrant TryFlushCachingOperators, when a Sink blocked while operators were in process, the should_reflush_current_operator == false branch still advances flushing_idx and skips the operator, so the in-process operators are never drained and output is lost.
reason: The fix adds && in_process_operators.empty() to that skip condition (plus an assert), directly correcting logic this refactor introduced.

defect: The test map used the invalid value 'always' for storage_block_prefetch; the fix uses the valid enum value 'always_prefetch'.
reason: Both the defect and the fix are in test code only, which the rubric classifies as a test change.

defect: The fix removes the #ifdef DEBUG around the throw in AssertNotNull, so null dereference checks now also throw in release builds, as an inlining and performance experiment.
reason: With the change, release builds had no null check, exactly as before the change; the fix is a behaviour and performance experiment, not a repair of a regression.

defect: The 'no candidate pruned means VARCHAR' heuristic also turns all-BOOLEAN columns (the last, most specific candidate) into VARCHAR; the fix adds SQLNULL as a final candidate so only all-empty columns keep every candidate.
reason: The same flawed heuristic was introduced the same day in 9f3f13b inside the dialect loop and already misdetected boolean columns; this change only moved the check to the final type selection.

defect: The fix replaces return std::move(op) with return op to silence pessimizing-move warnings.
reason: This is a warning and style cleanup with no behavioural effect.

defect: The fix renames has_unplanned_subqueries to has_unplanned_dependent_joins after the Binder member was renamed on master.
reason: has_unplanned_subqueries existed in binder.hpp at this change; the later rename, not this change, broke compilation.

defect: The widened uint64 BITPACK_MASKS table stops at 2^62-1 (63 entries), so 63- and 64-bit widths index past the end of the array and decode with garbage masks (#7652).
reason: The change set out to support 64-bit bitpacking but omitted the last two masks; the fix appends 2^63-1 and 2^64-1 and adds a size constant.

defect: The added D_ASSERT(child_validity.IsMaskSet() == false) followed by Initialize wrongly assumes the child vector's validity mask is never already allocated, so debug builds hit the assertion when the result vector is reused.
reason: The fix replaces the assertion and Initialize with Resize, correcting the incorrect validity-mask assumption made in the lines this change added.

defect: The new header includes the internal header with angle brackets (#include <duckdb/storage/checkpoint/string_checkpoint_state.hpp>) and is not self-contained, which the amalgamation script (it only inlines quoted includes) cannot resolve, breaking the CI build.
reason: The fix replaces that include with quoted includes of everything the header needs ('moved includes to fix ci'), repairing the build problem from the lines this change added.

defect: Interpreted .benchmark files are only loaded inside run_benchmarks, but parse_arguments handles --list (and exits) before that, so --list and other early paths do not see interpreted benchmarks.
reason: The fix moves the loading this change added into LoadInterpretedBenchmarks, called in main before parse_arguments; seeing the defect needs the --list handler and main, outside the diff hunks.

defect: The new exception thrown in TransformUpdate for materialized CTEs says they are not implemented 'for delete' instead of 'for update', a copy-paste error.
reason: The fix corrects only the wrong user-facing message that this change added.

defect: The added check tableref.external_dependency accesses a member through a unique_ptr<TableRef> with '.', which does not compile.
reason: The fix changes it to tableref->external_dependency ('fix compilation'); the diff shows tableref being moved into from_table as a unique_ptr.

defect: The fix threads an optional FileOpener through CachingFileSystem::OpenFile and CachingFileHandle so that GetFileHandle opens files with the opener.
reason: GetFileHandle already called file_system.OpenFile(path, flags) without an opener before this change; the change only added the QueryContext parameter.

defect: The fix adds an optional FileOpener parameter to both OpenFile overloads and passes it to file_system.OpenFile in GetFileHandle.
reason: The missing opener predates this change; the added overload without QueryContext simply mirrors the existing one.

defect: Passing target_scale instead of round_value to RoundPrecisionFunctionData gives DecimalRoundNegativePrecisionFunction a precision of 0 for negative rounding, so ROUND(decimal, -n) no longer rounds to tens or hundreds.
reason: The fix reverts to round_value (and fixes the early-out bound); seeing the problem needs DecimalRoundNegativePrecisionFunction's use of info.target_scale, outside the diff hunk.

defect: For the upgraded sqlite shell, the change stubs sqlite3_keyword_check to print 'unsupported' and always return 0, so the shell's .dump and quoting logic never quotes keyword identifiers and spams stderr.
reason: The fix ('Fix .dump in new shell') implements keyword_check with Parser::IsKeyword, replacing the stub this change added; seeing its effect needs shell.c.

defect: The fix rewrites if (count % GROUP_SIZE) as if (count % GROUP_SIZE != 0).
reason: The two conditions are equivalent; this is a style change.

defect: The reworked DbpDecoder discards the decoded block min_delta (leaving the sentinel INT64_MAX), copies MinValue(batch_size, ...) values instead of the batch_size - target_values_offset still needed, and counts Finalize's reads against total_value_count, giving wrong values and overruns.
reason: The fix assigns min_delta, bounds next by the remaining batch, and moves Finalize to an internal getter, all repairing lines this rewrite introduced.

defect: In ContainsGeneric the stop test offset > haystack_size - needle_size lets offset reach haystack_size - needle_size and then read haystack[offset + needle_size], one byte past the end, and the next memcmp also runs past the end.
reason: The fix changes > to >=, the off-by-one in the loop this change added (found by sqlancer).

defect: The new Value::ToSQLString wraps VARCHAR values in single quotes without escaping embedded quotes, so strings containing ' produce invalid or different SQL (#3140).
reason: The fix doubles the single quotes in exactly the VARCHAR case this change added.

defect: The fix repairs an unsigned underflow in buffer-size computation from leading-zero counts (CountZeros on uint64 versus sizeof(INPUT_TYPE)) in HexIntegralOperator and BinaryIntegralOperator.
reason: That leading-zero code was introduced later by af40d0ed573 ('count leading zero for to_hex'); this change's HexNumericOperator iterated over bytes and had no such underflow.

defect: SwizzleBlocks merges block_collection into swizzled_block_collection first and then swizzles every block of the target, so on a second call it re-swizzles already swizzled blocks; it also sets the referenced heap block count to 0, breaking later alignment.
reason: The fix ('aligning heap blocks more than once') iterates only over the new block_collection, sets the heap count, and merges afterwards; seeing it needs the callers that align repeatedly.

defect: SwizzleCollectedBlocks moves the new blocks into swizzled_block_collection and then loops over all of swizzled_block_collection->blocks, so blocks swizzled in an earlier call are swizzled again and paired with wrong heap blocks.
reason: The fix replaces this logic (still looping over the whole swizzled collection) with the corrected AlignHeapBlocks, which processes only the newly collected blocks; repeated calls happen in the external join sink.
